plain_statement: The edge function F of the Petersen graph minus a vertex (9 inputs, 12 edges, written as a list of two-digit codes ab for the edge a b). Give a circuit of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates the nine inputs and the wire AND(x_4, x_6). If it has at most 14 gates, the first gate that reads that wire is a NOT gate, and the output is not that wire, it does not compute F.
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate AND(x_4, x_6) computes its edge function
